text: Allocation-free downstream ordinal recovery required a narrow locus4s API: indexAtValidatedOrdinal, verified with JVM allocation court (2,000,000 recoveries <= 4096 bytes), full JVM/Scala.js/FullOpt/docs gates, and committed locally as locus4s 4aa95b5 atop branch agent/scala-guide.
